column6: The staging environment still times out after 30 seconds even though we raised the limit to 120.
Exporting a large account's history crashes the worker with an out-of-memory error.
After the nightly import some records are missing and nothing shows up in the logs.
This payments module is old and nobody likes touching it. Modernize it.
Report generation feels slow. Make it faster.
Split the god-object OrderManager into separate services.
Add a check for whether a user id is in the banned list on every request.
The mobile app shows a different tax rate than the web checkout.
Add retries to the payment webhook so we stop losing events.
We are on an old version of the date library. Upgrade everything to the new one.
